name: loadSound
description: Loads an audio file from disk and associates it with a unique identifier. Supported formats depend on the system's multimedia backend (typically MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC). If an ID already exists, the old sound is replaced.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Path to the audio file (absolute path recommended, or relative to Stellarium's working directory)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the sound object (e.g., 'background_music', 'alert_sound')

compatibility.notes: Requires Qt Multimedia module. Audio formats depend on platform.

name: playSound
description: Plays a previously loaded sound. If the sound is already playing, it restarts from the beginning. If the sound was paused, it resumes playback.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the sound to play

name: pauseSound
description: Pauses the playback of a sound. The sound can be resumed later with playSound().

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the sound to pause

name: stopSound
description: Stops the playback of a sound completely. The sound will restart from the beginning when playSound() is called next.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the sound to stop

name: dropSound
description: Unloads a sound from memory and releases its resources. The sound can no longer be played unless loaded again.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the sound to remove

name: position
description: Returns the current playback position of a sound in milliseconds. Returns -1 if the sound is not loaded or position cannot be determined.
returnDescription: Current position in milliseconds, or -1 on error

name: duration
description: Returns the total duration of a sound in milliseconds. Note: Duration may only be available after playback has started. Returns -1 if duration cannot be determined.
returnDescription: Total duration in milliseconds, 0 if unknown, -1 on error

compatibility.notes: Requires Qt Multimedia module. Duration may be unknown until playback starts.
